Coruscant is a fictional planet-wide city in a fictional galaxy; it is fiction, never presented as fact, and no copyrighted text is reproduced. This edition is a Signature-original design: it takes the source as inspiration and builds its own plan, labelled as Signature work wherever it departs from the source. It is never presented as an authentic public record, and no source text, artwork, or dialogue is reproduced.

Rank 15 of 16, weighted score 8.40. Technology level: L2. Feasibility: achievable. Planet: Coruscant. Teaching ladder: compounded. A physically impossible feature in this design, if any, is labelled design or speculative and is never claimed working. This blueprint never skips a technology level and never presents a higher-level outcome as available at a lower level.

Layout

A night lighting plan for the city levels: deck lights, lane signals, tower lights, and plaza lights as one grid.

Dimensions

Grid covers a district 2,000 m by 1,500 m; tower lights to 300 m high in the design.

Walls, gates, and districts

Deck edges and tower walls carry the light grid; no city wall.

Materials

Light housings, electric grid, signal lights.

Lighting and power

Deck, lane, tower, and plaza light; no sky-control claim is made.

Scale treatment

District-scale lighting grid; effects are light only.

Manifestation path

Any-planet: L1 orbital and terrain model plus habitat plan, then L2 pressurised test habitat and analogue-site build, then L3 planet-surface outpost, then L4 planet city. Life-support and radiation proofs at L2 gate L3; no level is skipped.

Districts

  • Deck lighting: street and plaza lights
  • Lane signals: sky-lane signals
  • Tower lighting: tower lights
  • Plaza lighting: gathering-deck lights

Ecosystems

  • Night sky: dark sky above
  • Deck air: lit deck air
  • Tower air: lit high air
  • Lower deck air: lit enclosed air

Caves and underground

Underground treatment, stated explicitly: buried cable runs, junction boxes, and drainage for light bases, all as designed.

Feasibility and technology level

Feasibility label: achievable. Technology level: L2. This level fits cleanly into the step-by-step manifestation path; it does not leap to a later level.

Acceptance tests

  • Every district has a lighting circuit
  • Lane signals run a full night cycle
  • No light described as controlling the sky
